prompt: Choose the best word or sentence for blank [145].
promptZh: 請選出最適合填入第 145 題空格的字詞或句子。

options.text: adds a slower greeting to the version that follows the host's welcome
options.zh: 讓接在主持人歡迎之後的版本加入一段較慢的歡迎詞
options.whyZh: 導演明確說歡迎詞步調維持不變，因此任何一版都不會增加較慢的歡迎詞。

options.text: changes the recorded directions in the version intended to follow the host
options.zh: 變更接在主持人之後的版本中，預先錄製好的引導說明
options.whyZh: 第一版的觀眾已經聽過主持人的走道說明，只有第二版錄音另外包含說明。

options.text: slows the whole recording intended for audiences who have not heard the host
options.zh: 讓未聽過主持人發言的觀眾所聽到的整段錄音都放慢
options.whyZh: 第二版是正確的目標，但須放慢的是裡面的走道指引，而不是整段錄音。

options.text: changes the pace of the directions only in the recording for audiences who have not heard the host
options.zh: 只放慢給未聽過主持人發言的觀眾所聽到的錄音裡的引導說明
options.whyZh: 走道指引只錄在給未聽過主持人發言的觀眾的版本，導演也只要求這段指引放慢。

explanationZh: 走道指引只錄在給未聽過主持人發言的觀眾的版本，導演也只要求這段指引放慢。
evidence: one for audiences who have already been welcomed by the host, and one for audiences who have heard nothing yet. / The second version includes separate directions for finding the side aisles / Slow down when you read the aisle directions, but keep the pace of the greeting as it is.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: one for audiences who have already been welcomed by the host, and one for audiences who have heard nothing yet.
The second version includes separate directions for finding the side aisles
Slow down when you read the aisle directions, but keep the pace of the greeting as it is.

vocabulary.term: keep the pace as it is
vocabulary.note: 只放慢指定的指引，不調整歡迎詞。
